name: 4D Language
description: 4D language support and tool4d language-server integration.

config.title: tool4d Executable
config.description: Optional explicit path to tool4d. When empty, the extension searches PATH, 4D Analyzer storage, and conventional installation locations.

config.title: 4D Project File
config.description: Optional explicit .4DProject file. Relative paths are resolved against the Nova workspace.

config.title: Startup Timeout
config.description: Seconds to wait for tool4d to connect to the local LSP bridge.

config.title: Shutdown Timeout
config.description: Seconds to wait before tool4d is forcefully terminated.

config.title: Skip On Startup
config.description: Prevent execution of project startup database methods.

config.title: Open Without Data
config.description: Open the project without a data file.

config.title: tool4d Log Level
config.description: Optional diagnostic log level passed to tool4d.
